name: Random picks (deterministic, game-id seeded)
rule_text: Bet the home side when the sum of the game id's characters is even, else the away side. Flat 1 unit. Deterministic and reviewable, so it cannot be re-rolled.

name: Favourites only
rule_text: Bet the aggregator favourite on every game. Flat 1 unit.

name: Coin-flip probability
rule_text: Assign probability 0.5 to the home team on every game. Its Brier score is 0.25 by construction; that is the floor every proper score is measured against.
